J1.purpose: 5.00 mm pitch; manual/wave soldering before core installation

J2.purpose: 5.00 mm pitch; manual/wave soldering before core installation

F1.purpose: Input fuse; JLCPCB stocked snapshot 2026-09-29; qualify inrush, 50 A interrupt limit and assembly thermal profile

D1.purpose: Traceable 1 A / 100 V reverse-input protection; shared exact MPN with D3. Apply 20% capacitive-load derating and verify temperature/inrush.

C1.purpose: Input reservoir; sizing assumes 4 uF total effective capacitance at 36 V from typical bias curve with margin; verify on prototype

C2.purpose: Input reservoir; sizing assumes 4 uF total effective capacitance at 36 V from typical bias curve with margin; verify on prototype

C3.purpose: 22 mOhm ESR, 3.3 A ripple at 100 kHz; C6 case 6.3 x 5.9 mm

C4.purpose: Current-production 1210 output bypass. Not credited in conservative bulk-ripple sizing; verify effective C and ripple temperature.

C5.purpose: 0603 bypass at about 3.1 V. Manufacturer typical DC-bias plot retains over 60% at 4 V; even 10% tolerance and 15% temperature allowance leave over 2 uF. Require >=1 uF effective on hardware; aging and actual bias/temperature behavior are not guaranteed by typical curves.

C6.purpose: Stocked 0805, 470 pF +/-5%, C0G, 100 V; above the 60 V absolute-to-ground prototype SW envelope. Retains the original damping capacitance; tune ringing on hardware.

R1.purpose: Lowered from 681k to provide 18 V startup margin with resistor/UVLO tolerances and input-diode drop. Hysteresis typical only; verify cold start.

R3.purpose: Coordinated stocked 113k/10.7k/127k selection; 0.1%, 25 ppm/C. Nominal 4.980 V; >=20% preliminary resistive margin at 17.5 V differential peak. Temperature-compensation ratio changes by -0.95%; output and temperature trim remain required.

R4.purpose: Coordinated stocked 113k/10.7k/127k selection; 0.1%, 25 ppm/C. Nominal 4.980 V; >=20% preliminary resistive margin at 17.5 V differential peak. Temperature-compensation ratio changes by -0.95%; output and temperature trim remain required.

R5.purpose: Coordinated stocked 113k/10.7k/127k selection; 0.1%, 25 ppm/C. Nominal 4.980 V; >=20% preliminary resistive margin at 17.5 V differential peak. Temperature-compensation ratio changes by -0.95%; output and temperature trim remain required.

R6.purpose: 39 ohm high-power thick-film snubber resistor, 2 W at 70 C with linear derating to zero at 155 C. Repetitive nanosecond pulse capability is not specified in the CRH datasheet; verify waveforms, mean loss and temperature on the first article.

R7.purpose: 22.7 mA nominal preload; covers minimum-energy pulses at L+15%, 1.04 A and 12.7 kHz

D4.purpose: Retain SMAJ12A for initial prototype tuning. Its 19.9 V clamp rating at 20.1 A does not establish converter pulse voltage. Require measured SW-VIN peak <=17.5 V including overshoot/uncertainty, verify RFB pin voltage/current and temperature; SMAJ11A is only a bench candidate.

U1.purpose: Industrial grade, same S8E package and pinout as LT8302E; guaranteed -40 to 125 C junction specification. Exact stocked normal LT8302, not LT8302-3.

T1.mfr: PCB winding + TDK factory-gapped core pair
T1.purpose: 2 x B66285G0050X187 factory-gapped halves + 2 x B66286A2000X000 clips; total gap 0.10 mm; measured assembled Lm acceptance 11.0-14.6 uH. No machining or bonding.

C7.purpose: Input damping reservoir through R8; 1.1 A ripple at 100 kHz, 40 mOhm maximum ESR, 8 x 10.2 mm. Not a surge clamp.

C8.purpose: Second output reservoir beside C3: combined 360 uF nominal / 288 uF at -20%, 11 mOhm parallel ESR bound at 100 kHz. Startup and ripple sharing require bench validation.

R8.purpose: Pulse-rated CRM2512 with manufacturer-recommended lands. 2 W at 70 C requires 300 mm2 combined pad/trace area; do not assume full rating on this board. Shunt damping branch only. Controlled input ramp first; board temperature and hard-step pulse qualification remain open.
